metadata.title: Analyze Current Artifact State
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Load and analyze an existing framework artifact (template, step, or process) to document its current state before making updates. Read-only step that parses artifact-specific structures and records the baseline.

artifactPath.description: Path to the artifact to analyze (relative to project root)

focusArea.description: Free-form description of what aspect to focus on. Agent interprets dynamically. If omitted, full analysis is performed.
examples: dependencies and what files it needs

output.description: Baseline analysis of artifact structure recorded to memory

prerequisites: Artifact path must be known (provided as parameter)
Artifact must exist (relevant files based on type)
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: validate params → locate files → load files → parse structure → record baseline
This is a READ-ONLY step — do not modify the artifact being analyzed
If focusArea is provided, interpret the free-form description to determine what to analyze
If focusArea is omitted, perform a full analysis of the entire artifact
For templates: parse steps array, parameters (required/optional), metadata, flow diagram
For steps: parse substeps, guidance, dependencies, memory usage, references
For processes: parse steps list, current state, subprocess state, parameters
Record all findings to memory.json — do not create separate artifact files

read: Artifact files based on type (see artifactTypeFiles below)

tools: read_file - Read artifact files for analysis
grep - Search for patterns within artifact files
bestPractices: Never modify the artifact being analyzed
Parse both MD and JSON files for comprehensive understanding
Adapt analysis depth based on focusArea parameter
Record structured data to memory, not free-form text
Log any issues found (missing files, malformed structure) but continue analysis
Use type-specific parsing logic — don't apply template logic to steps

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Read `~/.claude/agentic-processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md` and recall all principles
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Validate Parameters
substeps.description: Confirm all required parameters are valid
actions: Confirm `artifactType` is one of: template, step, process
Confirm `artifactPath` is provided and non-empty
If `focusArea` is provided, interpret what aspect to focus on and log interpretation
If required parameters are invalid, log error to log.json and stop

substeps.name: Locate Artifact Files
substeps.description: Construct expected file paths and verify they exist
actions: Based on `artifactType`, construct expected file paths using guidance.artifactTypeFiles
Verify required files exist
Note which optional files are available
If required files are missing, log error to log.json and stop

substeps.name: Load Primary Files
substeps.description: Read the main artifact files identified in previous substep
actions: Read all required files identified in Substep 2
Read available optional files
Store raw content for parsing in next substep

substeps.name: Parse Structure (Type-Specific, Focus-Aware)
substeps.description: Apply type-specific parsing logic, scoped by focusArea if provided
actions: If focusArea is not provided: parse the entire artifact structure
If focusArea is provided: interpret the description and focus on relevant parts
For templates: extract steps array, parameters, metadata, flow diagram
For steps: extract substeps, guidance sections, dependencies, memory usage, references
For processes: extract steps list, current state, subprocess state, parameters, status
Build a structured representation of the parsed data

substeps.name: Record Baseline to Memory
actions: Record:
- artifactType: type analyzed
- artifactPath: path analyzed
- artifactName: name extracted from artifact
- focusArea: area analyzed (null if full analysis)
- currentStructure: parsed structure object (type-specific)
- baselineTimestamp: current timestamp

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Linear with branching: Validate params → Locate files → Load files → Branch by artifactType (with focusArea scoping) → Record baseline to memory

fields: Information Produced: artifactType, artifactPath, artifactName, focusArea, currentStructure, baselineTimestamp
Decisions Made: Focus area interpretation (if applicable)
